# ClanTiers

`world-system`

A clan's tier, from every building it owns wherever it stands, weighed by how durable and how rare each block's material is. It rises as the clan builds and falls when its buildings are dismantled or destroyed. A tier gives nothing yet.

> Make a clan's standing the sum of what it has built (SkillsGrowFromWork, Phase 203)

## Actions

### score

Sum, over every block of every structure the clan owns, durability / durabilityUnit × rarityWeight

**Conditions:**
- Computed by the host from its structure index, never from a client message
- The tier is the highest whose minScore the score meets
